# Parka Blogs

> > Parka Blogs is a comprehensive resource for art book reviews, instructional guides, product recommendations, and urban sketching content created by Teoh Yi Chie from Singapore.

Parka Blogs combines curated book collections across art, design, comics, and video game art with hands-on product reviews of creative tools like tablets and monitors. The site also features the creator's own art courses and urban sketching documentation.

## Key Topics

- Art Books
- Urban Sketching
- Product Reviews
- Animation & Concept Art
- Drawing Techniques
- Video Game Art
- Comic & Manga
- Art Supplies
- E-ink Tablets
- Design Books
- Figure Drawing
- Instructional Art
- Teoh Yi Chie
- Singapore
- Tech Reviews

## Core Resources

- [Parka Blogs](https://www.parkablogs.com): Homepage featuring tech and art product reviews, iPad, BenQ, e-readers
- [About Parka Blogs](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/about-parka-blogs): Mission statement and background of Parka Blogs and its founder from Singapore
- [Teoh Yi Chie](https://www.parkablogs.com/users/teoh-yi-chie): Author profile for Teoh Yi Chie (Parka), the creator of Parka Blogs
- [My art and sketching courses](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/my-art-and-sketching-courses): Teoh Yi Chie's online art courses on urban sketching, pen, ink, and watercolor

## Art Book Collections

- [List of Art Books Reviewed](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/list-of-art-books-reviewed): Comprehensive index of reviewed art books including DreamWorks animation titles
- [Art Books from Asia](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/art-books-asia): Curated list of Asian art books featuring anime, manga, and artists like Mamoru Hosoda
- [Video Game Art Books: The List](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/video-game-art-books-list): Comprehensive video game art book collection including Sea of Stars and Diablo titles
- [Instructional and Reference Art Books](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/instructional-and-reference-art-books): Index of instructional art books covering drawing, painting, and illustration techniques
- [Anatomy and Figure Drawing Books for Artists](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/anatomy-and-figure-drawing-books-artists): Curated list of anatomy and figure drawing books by artists like Uldis Zarins
- [Upcoming Art Books](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/upcoming-art-books): Regularly updated list of forthcoming art books including Elden Ring and game art titles

## Design & Comics Collections

- [List of Comics Reviewed](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/list-of-comics-reviewed): Index of reviewed comics, manga, and graphic novels including DUNE and The Dam Keeper
- [List of Design Books Reviewed](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/list-of-design-books-reviewed): Catalog of graphic design book reviews including Graphis and advertising design titles

## Product Reviews & Guides

- [List of Art Products Reviewed](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/list-of-art-products-reviewed): Index of reviewed art supplies and materials from Dick Blick and Jackson's Art
- [List of tech products reviewed](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/list-of-tech-products-reviewed): Catalog of reviewed tech products including Huion tablets and shortcut remotes
- [Review: BenQ ScreenBar Halo 2 monitor light bar](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/benq-screenbar-halo-2-monitor-light): Product review of BenQ ScreenBar Halo 2 monitor light for desk lighting
- [Review: Bigme B751C S colour e-ink tablet](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/bigme-b751c-s-colour-e-ink-tablet-review): Product review of Bigme B751C S color e-ink tablet with Android 14

## Urban Sketching & Events

- [Sketching at the Singapore Airshow 2026](https://www.parkablogs.com/content/sketching-singapore-airshow-2026): Urban sketching article from Singapore Airshow 2026 event
